io.k8s.api.apps.v1.Deployment.description: Deployment enables declarative updates for Pods and ReplicaSets.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object. Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value.

kind.description: Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents. In CamelCase.

spec.description: Specification of the desired behavior of the Deployment.

status.description: Most recently observed status of the Deployment.

io.k8s.api.apps.v1.DeploymentSpec.description: DeploymentSpec is the specification of the desired behavior of the Deployment.

minReadySeconds.description: Minimum number of seconds for which a newly created pod should be ready without any of its container crashing, for it to be considered available. Defaults to 0.

paused.description: Indicates that the deployment is paused.

replicas.description: Number of desired pods. This is a pointer to distinguish between explicit zero and not specified. Defaults to 1.

revisionHistoryLimit.description: The number of old ReplicaSets to retain to allow rollback. Defaults to 10.

selector.description: Label selector for pods. It must match the pod template's labels.

strategy.description: The deployment strategy to use to replace existing pods with new ones.

template.description: Template describes the pods that will be created.

io.k8s.api.apps.v1.DeploymentStatus.description: DeploymentStatus is the most recently observed status of the Deployment.

availableReplicas.description: Total number of available pods targeted by this deployment.

readyReplicas.description: Total number of ready pods targeted by this Deployment.

replicas.description: Total number of non-terminating pods targeted by this deployment.

io.k8s.api.apps.v1.DeploymentStrategy.description: DeploymentStrategy describes how to replace existing pods with new ones.

rollingUpdate.description: Rolling update config params. Present only if DeploymentStrategyType = RollingUpdate.

type.description:
Type of deployment. Can be "Recreate" or "RollingUpdate". Default is RollingUpdate.

Possible enum values:
 - `"Recreate"` Kill all existing pods before creating new ones.
 - `"RollingUpdate"` Replace the old ReplicaSets by new one using rolling update.

io.k8s.api.apps.v1.RollingUpdateDeployme.description: Spec to control the desired behavior of rolling update.

maxSurge.description: The maximum number of pods that can be scheduled above the desired number of pods. Value can be an absolute number (ex: 5) or a percentage of desired pods (ex: 10%).

maxUnavailable.description: The maximum number of pods that can be unavailable during the update. Value can be an absolute number (ex: 5) or a percentage of desired pods (ex: 10%).

io.k8s.api.core.v1.ConfigMap.description: ConfigMap holds configuration data for pods to consume.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.

binaryData.description: BinaryData contains the binary data. Each key must consist of alphanumeric characters, '-', '_' or '.'.

data.description: Data contains the configuration data. Each key must consist of alphanumeric characters, '-', '_' or '.'.

immutable.description: Immutable, if set to true, ensures that data stored in the ConfigMap cannot be updated (only object metadata can be modified).

kind.description: Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.

io.k8s.api.core.v1.Pod.description: Pod is a collection of containers that can run on a host.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.

kind.description: Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.

spec.description: Specification of the desired behavior of the pod.

io.k8s.api.core.v1.PodTemplateSpec.description: PodTemplateSpec describes the data a pod should have when created from a template.

spec.description: Specification of the desired behavior of the pod.

io.k8s.api.core.v1.PodSpec.description: PodSpec is a description of a pod.

containers.description: List of containers belonging to the pod. Containers cannot currently be added or removed. There must be at least one container in a Pod.

initContainers.description: List of initialization containers belonging to the pod. Init containers are executed in order prior to containers being started.

nodeSelector.description: NodeSelector is a selector which must be true for the pod to fit on a node.

restartPolicy.description: Restart policy for all containers within the pod. Default to Always.

serviceAccountName.description: ServiceAccountName is the name of the ServiceAccount to use to run this pod.

volumes.description: List of volumes that can be mounted by containers belonging to the pod.

io.k8s.api.core.v1.Container.description: A single application container that you want to run within a pod.

args.description: Arguments to the entrypoint. The container image's CMD is used if this is not provided.

command.description: Entrypoint array. Not executed within a shell.

env.description: List of environment variables to set in the container.

imagePullPolicy.description: Image pull policy. One of Always, Never, IfNotPresent. Defaults to Always if :latest tag is specified, or IfNotPresent otherwise.

name.description: Name of the container specified as a DNS_LABEL. Each container in a pod must have a unique name (DNS_LABEL). Cannot be updated.

ports.description: List of ports to expose from the container.

resources.description: Compute Resources required by this container. Cannot be updated.

io.k8s.api.core.v1.ContainerPort.description: ContainerPort represents a network port in a single container.

containerPort.description: Number of port to expose on the pod's IP address. This must be a valid port number, 0 < x < 65536.

name.description: If specified, this must be an IANA_SVC_NAME and unique within the pod.

protocol.description: Protocol for port. Must be UDP, TCP, or SCTP. Defaults to "TCP".

io.k8s.api.core.v1.EnvVar.description: EnvVar represents an environment variable present in a Container.

value.description: Variable references $(VAR_NAME) are expanded using the previously defined environment variables in the container. Defaults to "".

io.k8s.api.core.v1.ResourceRequirements.description: ResourceRequirements describes the compute resource requirements.

limits.description: Limits describes the maximum amount of compute resources allowed.

requests.description: Requests describes the minimum amount of compute resources required.

io.k8s.api.core.v1.Volume.description: Volume represents a named volume in a pod that may be accessed by any container in the pod.

configMap.description: configMap represents a configMap that should populate this volume.

name.description: name of the volume. Must be a DNS_LABEL and unique within the pod.

io.k8s.api.core.v1.ConfigMapVolumeSource.description: Adapts a ConfigMap into a volume.

optional.description: optional specify whether the ConfigMap or its keys must be defined.

io.k8s.apimachinery.pkg.api.resource.Qua.description: Quantity is a fixed-point representation of a number, such as 100m or 1Gi.

io.k8s.apimachinery.pkg.apis.meta.v1.Lab.description: A label selector is a label query over a set of resources.

matchExpressions.description: matchExpressions is a list of label selector requirements. The requirements are ANDed.

matchLabels.description: matchLabels is a map of {key,value} pairs.

io.k8s.apimachinery.pkg.apis.meta.v1.Lab.description: A label selector requirement is a selector that contains values, a key, and an operator that relates the key and values.

key.description: key is the label key that the selector applies to.

operator.description: operator represents a key's relationship to a set of values. Valid operators are In, NotIn, Exists and DoesNotExist.

values.description: values is an array of string values.

io.k8s.apimachinery.pkg.apis.meta.v1.Obj.description: ObjectMeta is metadata that all persisted resources must have, which includes all objects users must create.

annotations.description: Annotations is an unstructured key value map stored with a resource that may be set by external tools to store and retrieve arbitrary metadata.

labels.description: Map of string keys and values that can be used to organize and categorize (scope and select) objects.

name.description: Name must be unique within a namespace. Cannot be updated.

namespace.description: Namespace defines the space within which each name must be unique. Cannot be updated.

resourceVersion.description: An opaque value that represents the internal version of this object. Read-only.

io.k8s.apimachinery.pkg.util.intstr.IntO.description: IntOrString is a type that can hold an int32 or a string.
